Question ID: Q050
Question: List closed topology connections with upstream and downstream asset names.

rank_trace.sql:
SELECT a1.asset_name AS upstream_asset, a2.asset_name AS downstream_asset, gt.connection_type
   FROM grid_topology gt
   JOIN assets a1 ON gt.upstream_asset_id = a1.asset_id
   JOIN assets a2 ON gt.downstream_asset_id = a2.asset_id
   WHERE gt.switch_status = 'closed'
   ORDER BY a1.asset_name, a2.asset_name;

SELECT a1.asset_name AS upstream_asset, a2.asset_name AS downstream_asset, gt.connection_type
   FROM grid_topology gt
   JOIN assets a1 ON gt.upstream_asset_id = a1.asset_id
   JOIN assets a2 ON gt.downstream_asset_id = a2.asset_id
   JOIN locations l ON a1.location_id = l.location_id
   WHERE gt.switch_status = 'closed'
   ORDER BY a1.asset_name, a2.asset_name;

SELECT a1.asset_name AS upstream_asset, a2.asset_name AS downstream_asset, gt.connection_type
   FROM grid_topology gt

   JOIN assets a2 ON gt.downstream_asset_id = a2.asset_id
   JOIN asset_types at1 ON a1.asset_type_id = at1.asset_type_id
   WHERE gt.switch_status = 'closed'
   ORDER BY a1.asset_name, a2.asset_name;
